t: Adjusts to the thickness of the plasterboard (9.5-15mm) and anti-rotational fins create a vice-like grip, preventing the fixing from moving or slipping once installed. Supplied with relevant screws / bolts.
b: Contents: Gripit 15 (8), 18 (8), 20 (8) & 25mm (8), 4 x 25 (8) & 5 x 30mm Screws (8), M6 x 20 (8) & M8 x 20mm Bolts (8)
Suitable for Hanging Radiators, Kitchen Cabinets & TV Mounting
No Need for Additional Noggings, Battens or Wall Stud Modifications
